title: Update on the Collateral Ratio Under Portfolio Margin of USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts (2026-01-23)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the  collateral ratio  and  Tiered Collateral Ratio for PM Pro  for the following assets under Portfolio Margin from  2026-01-23 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  30 minutes .
